main.selectBotDescription: Choose a bot from the sidebar to view its profile, or open settings to customize the theme, accent color, and background.

settings.title: Appearance & Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize theme mode, accent color, background media, and interface language.

theme.title: Theme Mode
theme.description: Switch between light, dark, or system color scheme.

accent.title: Accent Color
accent.description: Pick a highlight color for interactive elements and active indicators.

background.title: Background Image
background.description: Choose a local image or animated GIF as the application backdrop.

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the display language for the interface.
